description: Run a query against Grafana Loki

end.description: End time for the query (default: now)

filter.description: Filter log lines to only those containing this substring

filter_case_sensitive.description: When true, filter matching is case-sensitive (default: false)

format.description: Output format: raw, json, or text (default: raw)

head.description: Return only the first N log entries (oldest). Cannot be used with tail.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (default: 100)

org.description: Organization ID for the query (env: LOKI_ORG_ID)

start.description: Start time for the query (default: 1h ago)

tail.description: Return only the last N log entries (newest). Cannot be used with head.

name: loki_query
